# E-Force Drums

> Electronic drum kits with acoustic soul — wood shell design, exclusive finishes, born from Odery Drums Brazil. Site defaults to Portuguese (pt); also available in English, Spanish, Italian, German and Chinese via the same paths under /en/, /es/, /it/, /de/, /zh/.

## Brand

E-Force is an electronic drum kit line created by Odery Drums Brazil, combining acoustic-shell craftsmanship with electronic modules (F10 and F50). Prices below are in Brazilian Reais (BRL).

## Product line (kits)

- [EF2 V1](https://eforcedrums.com/pt/kits/ef2-v1): Entry kit, F10 module, R$ 3.454 — "Seu ponto de partida."
- [EF2 V2](https://eforcedrums.com/pt/kits/ef2-v2): F10 module, R$ 4.527 — "A primeira escolha do baterista."
- [EF2 V3](https://eforcedrums.com/pt/kits/ef2-v3): F10 module, R$ 5.103 — "O próximo passo natural."
- [EF2 V4](https://eforcedrums.com/pt/kits/ef2-v4): Intermediate premium, F10 module, R$ 7.770 — "Performance premium intermediária."
- [EF5 V2](https://eforcedrums.com/pt/kits/ef5-v2): Professional kit, F50 module, R$ 13.713 — "O instrumento do profissional."
- [EF7 Odery Eyedentity Hybrid](https://eforcedrums.com/pt/kits/ef7-eye-hybrid): Flagship, F50 module, R$ 23.527 — "O topo. A declaração."
